title: Some formulas crash
body:
I have more than one sheet in my file, and if i create a formula that needs some values from cells in another sheet, the value is displaying: #REF! While it opens well in the chrome browser on the phone and on the windows office excel.
And if i saved the sheet on the app, it will change all the formulas to display #REF! even on the browser and windows.
Ex: if i have the following formula in my sheet1:
=SUM(sheet2!B3:sheet2!B100)
And i saved it from the app, the formula will become:
=SUM('sheet2!B3:[''sheet2'']''sheet2'''!B100)
